Hi Arielle — thanks for the clear ask. We can support the conversion and keep your reseller economics intact; there are a couple of paths depending on TideCloud's preferred settlement flow. High level options:

1) Marketplace settlement with uplift pass-through: Redwood leaves the marketplace settlement as the canonical invoice and sends a separate reseller pass-through file to TideCloud’s partner for commission reconciliation. This is simplest for marketplace accounting teams.
2) Dual-invoice approach: Redwood invoices TideCloud for net usage; Redwood pays reseller uplift as a separate payout (easier for partners that need explicit line-item commissions).

Immediate next steps I can deliver by Monday EOD: a short evidence checklist, a proforma (metered pricing assumptions + first-month accelerator credit), and two recommended invoice flows (with pros/cons). Before I finalize, quick clarifying Qs:
- Do you need uplift to be a % of gross marketplace invoice or a fixed per-node payout?
- Is TideCloud expecting an accelerator (one-time) during the first 90 days to smooth economics?

I'll CC our channel ops SME Irene so she can confirm the pass-through mechanics.

Best,

Dylan / Ben / Mina — forwarding Arielle's note. My take and proposed defaults for commercial ops to sign off on (based on similar conversions):

Proposed uplift profile:
- Accelerator credit: 5% of first-month metered invoice (one-time) to offset one-off migration risk
- Intro uplift: 20% reseller uplift (applied to gross marketplace settlement) for first 3 months
- Ongoing uplift: 12% thereafter (standard reseller pass-through)

Pass-through mechanics (preferred): Redwood continues to flow marketplace settlements as usual; we provide a partner pass-through CSV mapped by invoice line item and attach it to the settlement notification. Partners reconcile and claim uplift within 30 days.

Minimum evidence pack (to attach to private offer):
- Signed reseller agreement with uplift clause
- Sample marketplace invoice showing gross -> net flows (redwood-proforma-DEAL-11873.xlsx will be draft)
- Mapping of metered SKUs to private-offer SKUs (Drive link included in reply)
- Sample partner payout file (CSV)
- PO/commitment amendment template for TideCloud procurement

Operational asks for Finance/Legal approval: Ben, can you confirm tax handling for uplift payouts (pass-through vs. Redwood gross) and whether we need an escrow holdback for the first quarter? Mina — please prepare the proforma with a metered consumption scenario (monthly projection at 60%, 80%, 100% of previous reserved consumption).
